name: Plan stage heading
does: Document title.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Zero-context self-contained tasks
does: Write a plan a zero-context developer can follow, each task a self-contained file read alone.
preventsClaim: a task file an implementer cannot act on without the rest of the plan
costNote: drives the redundancy rule and long task files

name: Input heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Working directory
does: Names the mise directory as the working directory.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Revise plan from done reality
does: Mid-execution revision plans only the remaining work; approving it clears done/ so every task is pending.
preventsClaim: a revised plan re-running work already in the repo

name: Bugfix route heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Bugfix uses fixed template
does: On the bugfix route, generate the plan from a fixed template after reading goals.md and the config.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: over-planning a one-line fix)
costNote: skips the exploration and design work of the feature route

name: Two tasks without exception
does: With no matching Test exception, the bugfix plan is exactly two tasks.
preventsClaim: unstated
costNote: T=2 for a standard bugfix run

name: Regression test task
does: Task 01_01 writes the regression test where goals.md records it, exercising the exact repro.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: a fix with no regression coverage)

name: Verify the test fails
does: Verify the test fails for the bug's reason; passing means it misses the bug, unrelated failure is a setup problem.
preventsClaim: a regression test that does not actually catch the bug

name: Copy guides, commit failing test
does: Copy matching Skills & guides entries into the task's Guides and commit the failing test.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Minimal fix task
does: Task 01_02 is the minimal fix that makes that test pass, naming the test file in Tests:.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: a fix wider than the bug)

name: Test file is frozen
does: The regression test file is frozen; the fix task may not modify it.
preventsClaim: the implementer weakening the test instead of fixing the bug

name: Single task under exception
does: A matched Test exception yields one fix task verified the exception's way, with evidence in the report.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: an impossible test blocking the fix)

name: Fill background, then critic
does: Fill each Background from goals.md with concrete code paths, then run the critic gate.
preventsClaim: unstated
costNote: routes the bugfix plan into the same critic loop

name: Feature routes heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Gather upstream sources
does: Gather goals.md, requirements.md with its REQ IDs, and the mocks if present.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Analyze the codebase deeply
does: Before writing, establish the patterns in play and the exact integration points.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: tasks that do not fit the codebase)

name: Delegate exploration to subagents
does: Delegate broad exploration to read-only `explore` subagents, one focused question each, compact summaries.
preventsClaim: filling the driver's context with source reading
costNote: N explore subagents per plan stage; no count bound stated in the file

name: Spot-check every cited line
does: Read directly only the most-cited files; spot-check every subagent file:line before using it.
preventsClaim: a hallucinated file:line reaching a task file

name: Write exploration notes file
does: Create implementation_plan/ and _exploration_notes.md holding subagent summaries; re-read it if context runs low.
preventsClaim: losing exploration findings when the driver's context fills

name: Design lives in overview
does: Put the design in 00_overview.md and build only what the requirements need.
preventsClaim: building beyond the requirements

name: Write task files yourself
does: Write the overview first, then each task file, sequentially and yourself, no subagents.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: inconsistent task files from parallel writers)
costNote: every task file is written in the driver's context; scales with task count

name: Plan critic gate invocation
does: Run the critic gate on implementation_plan/ with kind plan and requirements.md (or goals.md) upstream.
preventsClaim: an unreviewed plan reaching execution
costNote: 1 critic per round; budget 5, ceiling 8; the critic reads the overview plus every task file

name: Output structure heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Task filename convention
does: Task files are <phase>_<seq>_<task_name>.md, numbered in execution order.
preventsClaim: unstated (the engine matches leading NN_NN literally)

name: Overview template heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Overview summary section
does: Overview opens with a 2-3 sentence Summary of what is being built and why.
preventsClaim: unstated
costNote: the overview is the one plan file the orchestrator keeps in context

name: Overview design section
does: Design section covers components, data model, migration strategy, removal plan, sized to the change.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Overview assumptions section
does: Record non-obvious inferences made where the docs were silent and the default chosen.
preventsClaim: silent inferences in the design

name: Overview phases section
does: List each phase and what it achieves.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Overview phase rationale section
does: Explain the phase order: what depends on what, what unblocks testing early.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Overview end-of-plan gate section
does: Name the pre-existing e2e and sanity suites the final gate runs and the guides entry that runs them.
preventsClaim: the execute stage having to guess which suites to run
costNote: its absence forces the orchestrator's grep fallback

name: Overview task index table
does: Table of file, description, phase, requirements — the list the engine matches done/ against.
preventsClaim: unstated (the engine reads IDs from this table)

name: Task file template heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Task goal section
does: Task file opens with its title and what the task accomplishes.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Task requirements addressed
does: Each task lists the REQ IDs it addresses.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: untraceable requirements coverage)

name: Task background section
does: Background carries everything a zero-context reader needs: feature, prior task outputs, patterns, design decisions.
preventsClaim: an implementer that cannot work from the task file alone
costNote: the largest section of every task file, repeated per task

name: Task files to modify list
does: List each file to modify or create with what changes and why.
preventsClaim: unstated (it is what checklist rule 4 and the cap measure)

name: Task guides section
does: Copy matching config Skills & guides entries verbatim with required flags preserved.
preventsClaim: unstated (the implementer only sees what the task holds)

name: Task implementation details
does: Numbered steps naming specific functions, types, patterns.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Task testing suggestions
does: How to verify the task, the unit tests covering changed paths, or the Test exception and substitute.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Task gotchas section
does: List things that look right but are not.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Task verification checklist
does: Checkbox list of task-specific checks plus a Tests: line naming what to run or the exception.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: a task marked done unverified)

name: Key rules heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Redundancy is intentional
does: Repeat shared context in every task file rather than cross-referencing the overview or another task.
preventsClaim: a task file that cannot be read alone
costNote: multiplies plan-stage output by task count

name: Name concrete code
does: Name files, functions, and lines instead of saying "follow the existing pattern".
preventsClaim: vague instructions the implementer must re-derive

name: State prior task outputs
does: Say what prior tasks produced by file, type, and function, never "depends on Phase 2".
preventsClaim: a task that cannot locate its dependencies

name: Route the guides into tasks
does: Copy every matching config Skills & guides entry into the task; implementer and reviewer act on the task only.
preventsClaim: a guide the implementer never sees because it stayed in the config

name: Validation in every task
does: Every task's checklist names the unit tests to run, the tests it writes, and any cited exception's substitute.
preventsClaim: a task with no stated verification

name: No suite runs in tasks
does: Task checklists never name a pre-existing e2e or sanity suite, nor the generic quality commands.
preventsClaim: running the whole suite once per task instead of once per plan

name: Design principles heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Five source file cap
does: At most 5 source files per task; an unjustified breach is blocking, a justified one annotated in the index.
preventsClaim: tasks too large for one implementer pass
costNote: raises task count T, and every per-task subagent scales with T

name: Every task ends green
does: No red intermediate states: use expand-contract or bundle breaking changes with caller fixes.
preventsClaim: a plan whose middle tasks leave the build broken

name: Thin vertical slices
does: Each phase produces working, testable functionality end-to-end.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: horizontal layers with nothing testable)

name: Remove before building
does: Schedule removal of replaced code early.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: dead code left behind)

name: Earlier phases unblock later
does: Foundations first, enabling incremental testing.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Test as you go
does: Verification in every task, not a final test-everything phase.
preventsClaim: a plan that defers all testing to the end

name: E2e mandatory for user-facing
does: User-facing functionality gets e2e tests written and run by tasks unless a Test exception matches.
preventsClaim: shipping user-facing behavior with no e2e coverage
costNote: e2e writing and running inside tasks

name: Database migrations heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Use the migration command
does: Tasks use the config's migration generation command, never raw migration tools.
preventsClaim: hand-written migrations bypassing the project's generator

name: Do not list heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: No code in the plan
does: Describe, do not implement: no code or code snippets in plan files.
preventsClaim: the plan stage writing the implementation

name: No time estimates
does: Include no time estimates.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: No trivial tasks
does: Do not create tasks smaller than meaningful progress.
preventsClaim: task-count inflation
costNote: counterweight to the 5-file cap; each task costs 3-7 subagents

name: No uncited e2e omission
does: Never omit e2e coverage for user-facing functionality without a matching, cited Test exception.
preventsClaim: shipping user-facing behavior with no e2e coverage
